snippet.title: ReBirth: Rebuild & Resist | Official Trailer (2.0.7) | Rebuild a nation after disaster
snippet.description:
An earthquake, a flood or years of drought have torn a province apart, and an insurgency called the Shadow Front is filling the vacuum. You lead an international stabilization mission: rebuild roads, clinics and water, win back the people's trust, command your forces and end the war, ideally at the negotiating table rather than on the battlefield.

• 3 maps, 3 disasters (earthquake, flood, drought), each with its own mechanics
• Infantry, mechanized and special forces; air strikes with drones, helicopters and jets
• Crisis Desk 2.0: 7 missions, 7 games (dam, cholera, siege, election, convoy, hideout, winter)
• Election nights, press conferences, a monthly newspaper, day-night cycle
• Fully voiced, 6 languages, plays offline

▶ Google Play (free): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hantro.business
▶ PC (Windows/Linux, free browser demo): https://hanx-games.itch.io/rebirth
▶ Website: https://rebirthgame.tr/
